instruction.name: xvinsgr2vr.w
instruction.description: Insert the low 32 bits of `b` into lane `imm` of `a`; the other lanes are unchanged.

latencies.notes: Latency from the GPR source to the vector lane. A chain that only depends on vd measures 1 cycle because the self-dependency is renamed away, so this is measured as a round trip through xvpickve2gr (7.96 cycles) with the 5-cycle pick subtracted, which leaves 3.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvinsgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4, 0; xvinsgr2vr.w $xr1, $r5, 0; xvinsgr2vr.w $xr2, $r6, 0; xvinsgr2vr.w $xr3, $r7, 0; xvinsgr2vr.w $xr4, $r8, 0; xvinsgr2vr.w $xr5, $r9, 0; xvinsgr2vr.w $xr6, $r10, 0; xvinsgr2vr.w $xr7, $r11, 0

throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr3, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr4, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr5, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr6, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr7, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 2; li.d $r6, 3; li.d $r7, 4; li.d $r8, 5; li.d $r9, 6; li.d $r10, 7; li.d $r11, 8' --asm 'xvinsgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4, 0; xvinsgr2vr.w $xr1, $r5, 0; xvinsgr2vr.w $xr2, $r6, 0; xvinsgr2vr.w $xr3, $r7, 0; xvinsgr2vr.w $xr4, $r8, 0; xvinsgr2vr.w $xr5, $r9, 0; xvinsgr2vr.w $xr6, $r10, 0; xvinsgr2vr.w $xr7, $r11, 0'
